title: plugin-sharing: TeamGraphService.managerOf still answers null on a failed sys_user read and caches it for the pass
body:
domain:server#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXsK9j25sd7eVwW96G

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding from the #29713 dev (os-dev-report 6595695677, "TeamGraphService.managerOf also swallows and caches a failed sys_user read"). The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record on PR #29787 (6595814797, head `f357cc8f`) escalated it under ③/④ (S2) as a follow-up card. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3. Today no grant on `main` is computed from this read.

**Business reason.** PR #29647, PR #29703 and PR #29787 make every `plugin-sharing` read that decides who gets access refuse loudly on an outage instead of answering "nobody". `TeamGraphService.managerOf` is the last read of this family that still answers `null` on a failed read and caches that answer for the pass. Its reach today is the exported `expandPrincipal` `manager` arm and the wired `BusinessUnitGraphService.managerOf` limb. The first sharing or approval rule that names "the record owner's manager" would silently drop the manager during an outage.

## What happens

Read from source at `origin/main`, in `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/team-graph.ts`:

- `TeamGraphService.managerOf(userId, organizationId)` catches a failed `sys_user` read to `null` and caches it under `org::userId` for the pass.

## Wanted

- A failed read refuses: it throws through `readMembershipToCompletion` / `holderReadRefusal`, the same shape as #29787's `headOf` and standalone `managerOf`. Absence (`isObjectAbsentError`) still answers `null`, and nothing is cached after a failed read.
- Pins: a failed read refuses, absence answers `null`, and after recovery a second call answers the real manager. Ablate each negative pin once.
- Fold in from the same record:
  - **S3.** The CONTROL pin in `business-unit-head-manager-reads.test.ts` hard-codes `toBeNull()` for the wired limb on a failed read. It pins this swallow, so drop that one line when this lands.
  - **S4.** `holderReadRefusal` says "holder set" and "expansion" even for a single head or manager. Give it a third `lookup` arm rather than a local sentence.
- **S1 (spec prose, `packages/spec`).** The JSDoc "best-effort" on `IBusinessUnitGraphService.headOf` and `ITeamGraphService.managerOf` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`) should read "refuses on a failed read; `null` when none". Triage decides whether this rides as a cross-domain single PR or goes to a `domain:spec` carrier.
- Before changing anything, trace every caller of `TeamGraphService.managerOf` and `expandPrincipal`. If any caller would now fail a whole pass where it used to drop one person, stop and report.

Dedupe: searched `TeamGraphService managerOf`, `holderReadRefusal` and `failed sys_user read`. Only #29713 is related, and it is the sibling. **New.**

Links back: #29713, PR #29787, #29655, PR #29703, #29606, PR #29647.
